:root { --page-bg: #E4EAEE; --bar-bg: rgba(228,234,238,0.92); --bar-fg: #111E2B; --seg-bg: #FFFFFF; --seg-fg: #3E4C5A; --seg-on-bg: #111E2B; --seg-on-fg: #FFFFFF; --seg-border: #C9D3DA; color-scheme: light;
  box-sizing: border-box; padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px); }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { --page-bg: #0B1219; --bar-bg: rgba(11,18,25,0.92); --bar-fg: #E8EEF2; --seg-bg: #16212C; --seg-fg: #C9D3DA; --seg-on-bg: #7FD1BE; --seg-on-fg: #0B1219; --seg-border: #2A3846; color-scheme: dark; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --page-bg: #0B1219; --bar-bg: rgba(11,18,25,0.92); --bar-fg: #E8EEF2; --seg-bg: #16212C; --seg-fg: #C9D3DA; --seg-on-bg: #7FD1BE; --seg-on-fg: #0B1219; --seg-border: #2A3846; color-scheme: dark; }
html { scroll-padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); }
body { margin: 0; background: var(--page-bg); font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }
body::before { content: ""; position: fixed; inset: 0 0 auto; height: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 10; background: var(--bar-bg); }
.bar { position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 5; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--bar-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: var(--bar-fg); font-size: 13px; }
.seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--seg-border); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--seg-bg); }
.seg button { appearance: none; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 14px; color: var(--seg-fg); cursor: pointer; }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--seg-on-bg); color: var(--seg-on-fg); }
.stage { width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto 24px; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
.poster { width: 1200px; transform-origin: top left; }
.poster[hidden] { display: none; }
